history.rationale: HA2 K58I has been associated with increased HA stability in H5N1; substitution to isoleucine may improve hydrophobic packing in the central coiled-coil while preserving membrane-fusion competence.
No new evidence yet; retain as a hydrophobic core candidate plausibly favoring folding stability.
Extremely low PLM and minimal MSA; Lys->Ile disruptive.
Charge-changing substitution with very weak evidence.
T406 lies in the HA2 central helix; replacing polar threonine with isoleucine should increase helical propensity and hydrophobic core packing.
No new evidence yet; retain as a hydrophobic substitution near the HA2 core.
PLM slightly positive but MSA tolerance minimal; marginal.
Weak support from both evolutionary and sequence_plm evidence.
S399 is an exposed polar residue in an alpha-helical stalk region; alanine substitution may reduce solvent-exposed flexibility and slightly stabilize local helical structure.
No new evidence yet; retain as a helix-stabilizing alanine substitution.
Modest MSA (0.043) and positive PLM; Ser->Ala may reduce surface polarity but evidence is moderate.
Moderate evolutionary support but low sequence_plm; remains a secondary candidate.
A441 is a small hydrophobic residue in the HA2 helical bundle; conservative cavity-filling to valine may improve folded-state packing.
No new evidence yet; retain as a conservative buried-region change.
Weak MSA support, very low PLM; unlikely to improve stability.
Low evolutionary and sequence_plm scores; unlikely to improve stability.
Conservative hydrophobic substitution in a buried HA2 region; isoleucine may provide modestly improved side-chain packing without likely functional disruption.
No new evidence yet; retain as a conservative core substitution.
PLM positive (0.025) but MSA frequency low (0.006); conservative hydrophobic change.
Conservative change with modest evolutionary and sequence_plm scores.
Conservative hydrophobic replacement in the HA2 core; methionine may maintain packing while slightly increasing folded-state stability.
No new evidence yet; retain as a conservative hydrophobic alternative.
Leu->Met is conservative and MSA frequency 0.178 supports natural tolerance; PLM weakly positive.
L447M is evolutionarily tolerated moderately, but sequence_plm support is weak; retain as a conservative hydrophobic alternative.
A380 is a small residue near the HA2 fusion-loop/helix junction; valine may add hydrophobic packing while retaining backbone geometry.
No new evidence yet; retain as a candidate for improved hydrophobic packing.
Zero MSA support and low PLM; implausible.
No evolutionary support and low sequence_plm; lowest priority.
Glycine is a helix-breaker in the HA2 stalk; alanine increases alpha-helical propensity, although glycine flexibility may be functionally important.
No new evidence yet; retain as a backbone-flexibility-reducing change.
Low MSA and near-zero PLM argue against this substitution.
Low support across available evidence.
S458 is a solvent-exposed serine in the HA2 helical region; alanine removes a potentially labile polar side chain and may increase local stability.
No new evidence yet; retain as a helix-stabilizing alanine substitution.
ESM-1v strongly favors Ser->Ala (0.308) and MSA shows moderate tolerance (0.043); removing a polar side chain in HA2 likely stabilizes helical packing.
S458A has the strongest sequence_plm support and moderate evolutionary tolerance, making it the most plausible stability-preserving substitution.
G520 lies in a C-terminal ectodomain turn; substitution to alanine may reduce local backbone flexibility and modestly improve thermal persistence.
No new evidence yet; retain as a possible loop/terminal stabilization candidate.
Gly->Ala at 520 is highly represented in homologs (0.38), suggesting tolerated and possibly helix-stabilizing; PLM is modest but positive.
G520A has the highest evolutionary frequency among homologs, but low sequence_plm plausibility tempers confidence.
